thread:
alex: Heads up — customer reported double-quota charging when their client retries after a 502. They retried with a new Idempotency-Key and both requests counted.
maya: ugh. are we deducting at accept time? or on completion?
jamal: quick summary: currently we decrement quota at admission (so we can enforce burst limits). We mark a request as 'in-flight' and finalize on success/failure. If client retries with different idempotency key, admission sees capacity and decrements again.

sophie: right — that means duplicate logical work gets charged twice. For long-running async jobs this is especially annoying.

alex: what are the options? reserve then finalize? hold until completion? refund on duplicate detection?

maya: pros/cons:
- debit-on-admit: good for strict burst enforcement, but needs refunds when dedupe hits.
- debit-on-complete: avoids immediate double-charge, but burst control weak (clients can flood admissions and then backlog).
- reservation pattern: reserve a lightweight token on admission, then convert to actual charge on completion. refunds on dedupe are cancel of reservation.

jamal: implementation idea: store a dedupe fingerprint indexed by org+operation+input-hash (TTL 24h). Accept flow:
1) fingerprint lookup
2a) if exists and completed -> return cached response/status (or 409)
2b) if exists and in-flight -> attach wait or return 202 with reservation id
3) if not exists -> create fingerprint row, create reservation token (decrement burst pool counter), proceed to execute.
On completion commit reservation -> decrement final quota bucket; on failure release reservation -> increment burst pool back.

maya: code-ish:```http
POST /v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: 2b4f7...
X-Client-Fingerprint: sha256(base_prompt+params)
```
server: upsert into request_fingerprints (org, fp, status, reservation_id) values (...) on conflict do nothing;

sophie: need to be careful with races when two admissions run concurrently and try to create the fingerprint row. Use DB unique constraint + return existing reservation id. That avoids double-reservation.

jamal: also consider accounting events emitting in two phases: reservation_event (kind=reserve) + commit_event (kind=charge) so Analytics/Console can show pending vs final charges.

ops-bot: incident note added: #INC-2026 duplicate-quota-charges - linked to thread 1765123459

alex: good call on telemetry. We should add dashboard panels: 
- pending_reservations_by_org (gauge)
- reservation_commit_rate & reservation_refund_rate
- duplicate_charge_rate (count of times fingerprint dedupe prevented double final charge)

maya: rollout plan: feature-flag for reservation mode per-cluster + canary on low-volume orgs. Start with refund-on-detect fallback for existing clusters where we can't change admission semantics.

sophie: will need migration window and retention TTL for fingerprint rows (24-72h). Also add an admin endpoint to force-release stuck reservations.

alex: any concerns about backing store perf? we need <1ms path for admission check to not blow latency SLOs.

jamal: use a sharded Redis hyperlog for quick existence + fall back to DB for authoritative. Redis key: fp:{org}:{sha256} -> {reservation_id, status} TTL 48h. DB as source of truth.

maya: client guidance: encourage clients to set stable Idempotency-Key per logical request; but we can't rely on that. Also recommend exponential backoff and only retry on idempotent ops.

sophie: I'll draft the console metrics and wire up an alert when duplicate_charge_rate > 0.1% for any org. We should also surface pending reservations on org usage page.

alex: ok let's move this to an RFC. Action items:
- jamal: prototype reservation + fingerprint upsert (db+redis) (ETA 1w)
- sophie: dashboard/alerts (ETA 3d)
- maya: client guidance doc + API header docs (ETA 4d)
- ops: create rollback plan for refunds (sophie)

maya: also add a unit/integration test for concurrent admissions (simulate twin requests with different idempotency keys but same fingerprint).

alex: thanks all. If we see customer pain, we'll temporarily issue refunds and enable reservation feature-flag for that region. :thumbsup:
